name: Ribbon Mark
summary: Bookmark toggles whose satin ribbon unrolls down the book cover, swings like cloth and catches the light
about: A reading list of three drawn book covers, each with a brass bookmark clasp. Pressing a clasp lifts the book and unrolls a satin ribbon that swings on a small cloth simulation, catches a sheen of light and sends up gold sparks while the book's spine drops onto the shelf below. Pressing again whips the ribbon back up and slides the spine away; the ribbons sway in a soft breeze and move when your pointer brushes them.
how: Press the brass clasp on a cover (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space) to bookmark that book.
Watch the ribbon unroll, swing and settle while the saved count rolls up and the spine lands on the shelf.
Brush the ribbon with your pointer to push the cloth around.
Press the clasp again to pull the ribbon back up and take the book off the shelf.
